title: The tip flow — no login, entered by printed QR
why: `tips.html` is a second, divergent implementation of a capability MAYA already has: ATips inside the app (`app-tenant.html` L6612). One MAYA means one tipping capability with two entry points — authenticated in the app, anonymous from the printed QR. The flow is linear and already declares its own parameters: presets 100/200/300/500/1000 plus a custom amount bounded min 50 / max 15000, five copy actions (SBP phone, bank, amount, comment, all), and an «Открыть банк» CTA that hands the client off to the master's external YClients tips URL — not to a bank app. Those parameters describe a flow that does not work today: `isConfigured()` requires an sbpPhone of at least 10 digits **and** a non-empty sbpBank, and every master in `tips-data.js` ships both fields empty (verified 5/5), so every copy button and the CTA are disabled and all five masters show «реквизиты не заполнены». Filling in the masters' details is part of this merge, not a follow-up.
disappear: The bespoke multi-screen flow — the separate master-select, amount and transfer-details screens — folds into a single `tips` widget sequence, and the two implementations stop diverging: one set of tipping logic and one data source behind both entry points. Which surface they fold into is precisely what this signature settles; the row leaves the merge target unnamed. The disposition is MERGE with retirement condition RETIRE AFTER PARITY (K16), and the row is explicit that retirement does not take the public entry with it — a no-auth landing for the printed QR survives.
remain: Master selection by slug (`?master=<slug>`), every preset and the custom amount with its bounds (min 50 / max 15000), all five copy actions, the «Открыть банк» hand-off to the master's external YClients tips URL, and the «Я перевёл» acknowledgement — **which stays an acknowledgement and never becomes a payment confirmation**, because no payment is observed. The session-less entry remains too, and it is load-bearing: today the page works with no login, no PWA install and no session — a walk-up client scanning the QR on the chair — so the address on the printed cards must keep resolving to a public, no-auth landing. That landing holds no client data and grants no authority; it is a deliberately public surface, not an exception to server-side authority. And the five masters' SBP details have to be filled, or parity with today is parity with a surface on which nothing is clickable.
risk: LOW-MEDIUM — two hazards, not one. First, «Я перевёл» is the same shape as GAP-ATTENDANCE-CONFIRM: a user assertion about something the system did not witness. Today it is pressed with no login and no session, so it is attached to no identity; if the merged flow stores it, it must be stored as an unwitnessed client assertion and never surfaced, or read back, as a confirmed transfer. Second, the entry is physical and unrecallable: printed QR cards already in the salon point at this page's `?master=<slug>` address, and merging the flow into the authenticated chat experience would kill exactly the flow those cards serve. The rating stays LOW-MEDIUM rather than rising, because the row already names the mitigation — keep a public no-auth landing — no money moves through MAYA (the CTA hands off to an external YClients URL), and a card leading to a surface where nothing is clickable is the state of all five masters today. It would rise only if the merge shipped without that public landing.
user_impact: The client is who notices, and the diagnosis of today's dead end holds — but the promised payoff does not. Verified as stated: a walk-up client who scans the printed chair QR lands on tips.html?master=<slug> (generate_tip_qrs.py encodes exactly that), picks a master and an amount, and can then do nothing. isConfigured() (tips.html L1243) requires sbpPhone with >=10 digits AND a non-empty sbpBank; all five masters in tips-data.js ship both empty while all five carry a populated bankAppUrl, so the five copy buttons and "Я перевёл" are disabled (L1366) and even "Открыть банк" is disabled (L1370-1378, gated on `configured &&` despite the URL existing), with "реквизиты не заполнены" on every master (L1327). What is NOT true is that the merge makes the payment hand-off complete for the first time. GAP-TIPS is open (ownerState "none", closedAt null), and under the certified contract PAY.5 tips are a payment-class capability following PAY.1-PAY.4; PAY.4 says that while no payment-class owner is registered the emission carries capability_gap_ref, a null commit_intent and a null continue_intent and "states in text that the purchase cannot be completed in the product yet — a gap-blocked commit renders as prose, never as a disabled-styled button". R3.3.1 additionally makes BUTTON → EXTERNAL PROVIDER unconstructible, so bankAppUrl cannot travel into the widget at all, and AE_FAMILY_FLOOR sets money: STEP_UP_VERIFIED, a level frozen as unreachable. So the contract-declared successor replaces a disabled button with prose; it does not deliver a completed hand-off, and masters do not start seeing tips arrive from this route on the strength of this signature. Two further corrections: signing G16 changes no deployed byte (dossier §5), and the dead end is in any case a one-line data-or-gating fix to a live static page that needs no merge to land — the working sibling path (app.html L22213 __tipsSend → L10655 meTipsPaymentURL) already completes the hand-off with no SBP data. Finally, the real user-facing risk this group carries is the opposite of the one claimed: S-170 is the anonymous, session-less, no-install QR landing, and a chat-first successor behind a SESSION_VERIFIED floor would kill exactly the flow the printed stickers serve — S-170's own parityRiskNote says so, and the dossier's conditional for G16 records only the wording constraint, not the preservation of the anonymous entry.
security_impact: The direction is wrong in both halves. First half: it is true that S-170 today is roleMode "any", makes no network call and carries no session, token or role check, so no client-side check is being removed that a server-side check must replace — but the conclusion "neutral" is wrong, because the successor ADDS an authority floor where none existed (money family floor STEP_UP_VERIFIED, frozen unreachable) and removes an external-provider button the contract forbids outright (R3.3.1). That is a hardening plus an availability loss for the anonymous walk-up, not neutrality. Second half is inverted and must be struck: folding "Я перевёл" into a server-backed widget would NOT "create the first persisted record of a claim the system never witnessed". That record already existed — POST /api/tips/sent wrote database.save_tip and fired a Telegram alert ("Клиент отметил перевод чаевых") plus web push from an endpoint with no auth whatsoever, caller-supplied master/amount/record_id (SECURITY_AUDIT_2026-06-22_DEEP.md:400-407) — and it has already been retired: webhook_server.py tip_sent_handler now returns 410 "tip_signal_retired" with payment_confirmed:false, business_mutations:0, under the marker p5_b22_unverified_tip_signal_retired. B22 Option A (RECOMMENDED) is explicit: "Durable tip fact: no", "Staff notification: none", no canonical tip owner in Maya V1. So prescribing that the claim "must be stored and rendered as a client assertion" is not a safety caveat — it would reverse a decision the repo has already implemented and re-create a spoofable, unauthenticated staff-notification primitive. The correct constraint is stronger than GAP-ATTENDANCE-CONFIRM shape: while GAP-TIPS is open there is no durable tip fact and no button at all, only gap prose (PAY.4/PAY.5). Third claim also struck: the merge does not mandate placing masters' personal SBP phone numbers into tips-data.js. The working sibling implementation needs no SBP data, the contract forbids carrying the provider URL anyway, and tips.html's own footer records the deliberate standing decision ("Реальные телефоны СБП хранятся только в локальном конфиге проекта"). Publishing those numbers is one bad way to fix the dead end, not a consequence of the disposition. Worth recording instead, and unmentioned by the entry: tips-data.js already publishes five per-master YClients tip tokens (the bankAppUrl UUIDs) in an unauthenticated static script (L1178) — an existing exposure the contract-declared successor would actually remove.
